description: Page this tenant's OAuth auth audit log (authorize/consent/token/refresh/revoke/ policy_change/approved/denied/refused events), newest additions last. Optional since/until (unix seconds) and event filters; limit defaults to 50, max 500; cursor resumes from a previous page's cursor field.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.oauth.audit
